text:
ana: RFC follow-up: propose splitting eviction into Allocator (rank + issue token) and Owner (apply + safety). sketch below. wanting quick sanity check on failure modes.

chris: high level ok. main concern is detection when owner crashes after ack but before apply.

yuki: suggest lightweight token with fields: prefix, lease_epoch, token_id, expires_at, hmac. owner must persist pending entry before ACK, then CAS prefix epoch when applying. if CAS fails treat as NACK.

ana: small nit: call the epoch field lease_epoch to avoid confusion with other epochs.

ana: question: who is the source of truth for outstanding tokens? allocator keeps an index but reconciler should compare allocator index vs owner journals.

yuki: reconciler pattern: periodics scan outstanding tokens > TTL, read owner pending journals, if pending without apply -> replay or escalate. idempotency via token_id prevents double-apply.

sre-bot: canary: evict-split v0.1 -> small-canary nodeset at sha:facade.

chris: rollout in soft-demote mode first (token lowers priority not evict) to reduce blast radius. add chaos test for crash-between-ack-and-apply.

yuki: metrics: token_issue_rate, owner_pending_count, reconcile_action_rate, prefix_stale_reads. alerts if prefix_stale_reads > 0 for 5m.

ana: plan to prototype token + owner journal this week and open draft PR. pairing with @chris for correctness notes.

chris: +1.
